abstract: BACKGROUND: Germ cell testicular cancer (TC) patients have an increased risk of developing a contralateral TC. This paper presents a retrospective analysis of patients with bilateral TC from a database of a single center and aims to highlight the need for an individual approach. MATERIAL AND METHODS: In the study period from January 1970 to June 2013, a total of 1,438 patients with primary TC were diagnosed. The group comprised of 1,370 patients with unilateral TC and 68 patients with bilateral TC. Bilateral TC patients were evaluated regarding the age at presentation and the histology of tumor and then compared with the group of patients with unilate-ral TC. RESULTS: The mean age of the patients with unilateral TC was 31.7 years. This group of patients consisted of 408 patients with seminoma and 962 patients with non-seminomatous TC. The group of 68 patients with bilateral TC involved 63 patients with metachronous disease and five patients who developed TCs simultaneously. The mean age at diagnosis of primary tumor in patients with metachronous bilateral TC (25.8 years) was significantly earlier in comparison to patients with unilateral disease. Among 24 patients with seminoma there were 17 patients who subsequently developed a second malignancy of an identical histological type. In the group of 39 patients with initial non-seminomatous TC there were 15 patients with discordant histology of the second tumor. In the metachronous disease group, patients with primary seminoma were significantly older than those with initial non-seminomas. CONCLUSIONS: All patients with unilateral TC have an increased risk of developing a contralateral TC, years and even decades after the initial diagnosis. Management of subsequent TC should be individualized for each patient according to the histology and clinical stage of the primary tumor, as well as the therapeutic strategy applied initially. The further management should involve a long-term follow-up and life-long testosterone substitution.
abstract_ja: 背景: 精巣がん(TC)の患者は、対側精巣にもがんを発症するリスクが高い。本稿は、単一施設のデータベースから両側性精巣がん患者を後方視的に解析し、個別化されたアプローチの必要性を示すことを目的とする。対象と方法: 1970年1月から2013年6月までに、原発性精巣がん1,438例が診断された。内訳は単側性精巣がん1,370例と両側性精巣がん68例であった。両側性精巣がん患者について、診断時年齢と腫瘍の組織型を評価し、単側性精巣がん患者群と比較した。結果: 単側性精巣がん患者の平均年齢は31.7歳であった。この群はセミノーマ408例と非セミノーマ性精巣がん962例からなる。両側性精巣がん68例のうち、63例は異時性発症、5例は同時発症であった。異時性両側性精巣がん患者の原発腫瘍診断時の平均年齢(25.8歳)は、単側性疾患患者より有意に若かった。セミノーマ患者24例のうち17例は、同一組織型の二次性悪性腫瘍を発症した。初回が非セミノーマ性精巣がんであった39例のうち15例は、第2腫瘍の組織型が異なっていた。異時性疾患群では、初発がセミノーマの患者は非セミノーマの患者より有意に高齢であった。結論: 単側性精巣がん患者は、初回診断から数年、さらには数十年後にも対側精巣がんを発症するリスクがある。対側腫瘍の管理は、初回腫瘍の組織型と臨床病期、初回の治療戦略に応じて個別化すべきである。長期フォローアップと生涯にわたるテストステロン補充療法が必要である。
